Our Story

Addressing the Gift Card Dilemma

Traditional gift cards often end up underused or forgotten due to their limited applicability. Rewarble reinvents this model, offering gift cards that can be redeemed widely, even for digital platforms or e-wallet top-ups. With Rewarble, every gift card ensures satisfaction by providing complete freedom of choice.

Meet the Team

"Our Team" consists of pioneers in the digital space, dedicated to transforming the way we use gift cards. We aim to create a system that aligns with the modern digital consumer's needs and preferences.

Our Mission and Vision

Rewarble is committed to transforming the gift-giving landscape by prioritizing consumer choice. We see a future where gift cards are always a delight to receive and use. In pursuit of this, we consistently evolve our offerings to meet varied needs, making our gift cards a source of happiness and convenience.

We're here for you

We'd love to hear from you! Do you have any questions, suggestions, or simply want to chat about the future of gifting? Feel free to contact us at our� [support]. We value your feedback and look forward to further revolutionizing the gift card experience with you. Join us on this journey, and let's redefine the gift card industry together. Let's make gifting an experience of freedom, flexibility, and joy. Let's make it Rewarble.

FAQ's

Where can I purchase Rewarble Vouchers?

You can find where to buy Rewarble Vouchers on our distributors' page, which includes links to their sites. Our distributors offer various payment methods, which may vary by distributor.

What are the fees for redeeming a Rewarble Voucher?

Our fees page provides an overview of the charges per brand. If a brand is not listed, there are usually no fees. Additionally, there's a cost calculator on the brand page to help you determine the exact amount you will receive. Different fees apply for VISA and Mastercards, and these can be found in the respective product terms and conditions.

How do I top up my Rewarble Visa / Mastercard?

If you have created a virtual Visa or Mastercard in your Rewarble account, you can use it for online payments. To top it up when your balance is low, simply redeem more Rewarble Vouchers on your account and add the funds to the card. This way, you don't need to generate and link a new credit card to your accounts repeatedly.

How long are Rewarble Vouchers valid?

Rewarble Vouchers are valid for 12 months from the date of issuance. When you redeem your voucher on your account, an additional 12 months of validity is added. Rewarble Vouchers are designed for relatively quick use, so make sure to redeem them promptly.

Can I top up my Rewarble balance without a voucher, using a payment method instead?

Rewarble exclusively uses vouchers, so your Rewarble balance can only be topped up with Rewarble Vouchers. This allows you to purchase Rewarble with over 100 different payment methods at various locations.

Are there any limits associated with my Rewarble account?

To comply with AML regulations and combat fraud and money laundering, Rewarble enforces strict limits on voucher redemption. You can easily increase your limits by completing the KYC process, which takes just a minute. Your information is securely stored with our KYC provider, ShuftiPro, which is GDPR and DSS Compliant.
